title: 2b-D: per-turn child reads its credentials over the supervisor socket and holds none in its environment
description:
Contract: docs/OWNER_CREDENTIAL_RENEWAL.md (sections 2 F2 F3 F9 F16, 3 R10 R11 R12, 5 socket schemas, 8.3, 8.4, 12.2, 17 D). Gherkin first (features/computer_owner_credential_renewal.feature, tags @child and @image).

The per-turn child holds no credential in its environment and reads its turn's credentials from the supervisor over a local filesystem socket, so a turn can run longer than an hour.

Files:
- computer/host/src/supervisor-socket.ts (new): the server on OWNER_SUPERVISOR_SOCKET_PATH (listen under umask 0o177 after the directory is made and locked, remove a stale socket first and the socket at exit, only while a child runs, at most 4 connections, one newline-terminated JSON request of at most 1 KiB, ownerSocketRequestSchema, answers from the TurnCredentialSource of P0, no_turn for a dispatch that is not served, expired when the held credentials are past their end, log owner_credential_socket with op and outcome and never a value); supervisor-main.ts creates it. Never an abstract socket, never TCP.
- computer/host/src/supervisor-child-environment.ts: no AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN or CHATTICUS_MODEL_GATEWAY_TOKEN; adds CHATTICUS_SUPERVISOR_SOCKET; its vitest.
- computer/host/src/owner-deps.ts, owner-models.ts, owner-main.ts: SupervisorSocketClient; new DynamoDBClient with a credentials provider and new S3Client with a credentials provider; ModelGatewayConfig.token becomes a token provider applied per HTTP request in the fetch wrapper (unconditional, sets Authorization; the Pi resolve returns a placeholder); the provider throws on no_turn or expired (the turn ends as an error, exit 70); nothing falls back to the environment or the default chain.
- conversation/test/container-owner-config.test.ts, owner-session-env.test.ts: updated for the missing environment.
- conversation/test/computer-image-structure.test.ts: a guard over the child's sources: no AWS client constructed without credentials, no reference to the container credentials endpoint or the instance metadata service.
- computer/test_owner_container.sh: as the unprivileged shell user the command cannot list /run/chatticus, open the socket, or read the environment of the supervisor or the child, and cannot reach a loopback port of the supervisor (it holds none).
- Steps: conversation/features-support/steps/ (a new file for the socket and the child provider; reuse the fake spawner and clock).

Scenarios owned: 'A child reads its credentials from the supervisor and holds none in its environment', 'A turn that runs past the first hour keeps working', 'A child whose credentials could not be renewed fails closed', 'The model gateway token is read for each request', 'The child holds no AWS client without explicit credentials', 'The shell cannot reach the supervisor socket or the credentials', 'A turn that is not the one being served gets nothing over the socket'.

Acceptance (from conversation/): typecheck; npm test; npm run test:features; computer/test_owner_container.sh passes against a built image (CI builds sha-<commit>; do not promote).

Dependencies: P0. Integrates with C in E.

Rules: no emojis, no line comments, TSDoc on public exports. Do not read or write project/.
right_now_summary: The child fetches per-turn credentials over a protected supervisor socket instead of using environment variables.
